description: Who renders and with which limits: signedIn, plan, limits.maxSeconds (longest render) and limits.watermarkAfterSeconds (renders longer than this carry a spoken tag; null = never), usageToday, and when not signed in a loginHint. Use it to plan within the limits (keep an anonymous draft at or under watermarkAfterSeconds). Never starts a sign-in: to sign in, run the loginHint command and ask the user to approve the code it prints.
name: code_account
title: TuttiCode sign-in and limits
